info.title: pdfnetstack: compress, merge, split and encrypt PDF files from the command line
info.description: Cross-platform command line tool to compress, optimize, merge, split, rotate, encrypt and decrypt PDF files. Lossless by default, every output verified against its source, optional JPEG quality reduction, batch mode with CSV reports. MIT licensed, no Ghostscript. Install with: dotnet tool install -g PdfNetStack.Tool. By Jamal Abdelkhalek, JADEV.

options.name: --balanced
options.description: Faster Flate levels (default: maximum)

options.name: --exhaustive
options.description:
Exhaustive Flate search for archival jobs: a few
percent smaller, many times slower

options.name: --no-object-streams
options.description: Write a classic xref table, no object streams

options.name: --no-dedup
options.description: Do not merge identical objects

options.name: --no-prune
options.description: Keep resources no content uses

options.name: --no-compact
options.description: Do not rewrite content streams compactly

options.name: --no-font-merge
options.description: Do not merge subsets of one TrueType font

options.name: --linearize
options.description: Write a linearized file (fast web view)

options.name: --streaming
options.description:
Read the input on demand and write the rewrite
through a temporary file, proven there: memory
stays bounded for files larger than memory, and
inputs of any size are accepted

options.name: --no-recompress
options.description: Do not re-encode streams

options.name: --no-group4
options.description: Do not re-encode bilevel images as CCITT Group 4

options.name: --no-image-predictors
options.description: Do not try PNG prediction on raw images

options.name: --no-jpeg
options.description: Do not re-encode JPEG images

options.name: --jpeg-quality
options.description:
Requantize JPEG images to this quality (lossy);
verify: accept images requantized this way

options.name: --max-dpi
options.description: Downsample images drawn above 1.5 times n dpi to n (lossy)

options.name: --to-jpeg
options.description:
Re-encode photographic raw and JPEG 2000 images as
JPEG at --jpeg-quality (lossy)

options.name: --quantize
options.description:
Reduce raw RGB images to a palette when that stays
faithful: drawings and screenshots (lossy)

options.name: --preset
options.description:
balanced: palette, JPEG 75, SSIM at least 0.95.
smallest: palette, JPEG 50, 150 dpi, SSIM at least
0.90. Both lossy; options after it change it

options.name: --min-ssim
options.description:
Perceptual gate: keep any image whose lossy change
falls below this SSIM; verify: accept downsampled
and converted images that meet it

options.name: --progressive
options.description: Write JPEG progressively when that is smaller

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: Skip the equivalence proof (not recommended)

options.name: --allow-incremental
options.description: Flatten files with incremental updates

options.name: --allow-repaired
options.description: Rewrite damaged files that needed repair

options.name: --strip-thumbnails
options.description: Remove page thumbnails (not lossless)

options.name: --strip-pieceinfo
options.description: Remove application private data (not lossless)

options.name: --min-saving
options.description: Minimum saving to keep a rewrite (default 1)

options.name: --threads
options.description: Threads per document (default: all cores)

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Documents processed in parallel by batch (default: all cores)

options.name: --report
options.description: Batch: write one row per document

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine readable output

options.name: --no-optimize
options.description: Editing: save without the optimizer pass

options.description:
balanced: palette, JPEG 75, SSIM at least 0.95.
smallest: palette, JPEG 50, 150 dpi, SSIM at least
0.90. Both lossy; options after it change it

options.name: --min-ssim
options.description:
Perceptual gate: keep any image whose lossy change
falls below this SSIM; verify: accept downsampled
and converted images that meet it

options.name: --progressive
options.description: Write JPEG progressively when that is smaller

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: Skip the equivalence proof (not recommended)

options.name: --allow-incremental
options.description: Flatten files with incremental updates

options.name: --allow-repaired
options.description: Rewrite damaged files that needed repair

options.name: --strip-thumbnails
options.description: Remove page thumbnails (not lossless)

options.name: --strip-pieceinfo
options.description: Remove application private data (not lossless)

options.name: --min-saving
options.description: Minimum saving to keep a rewrite (default 1)

options.name: --threads
options.description: Threads per document (default: all cores)

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Documents processed in parallel by batch (default: all cores)

options.name: --report
options.description: Batch: write one row per document

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine readable output

options.name: --no-optimize
options.description: Editing: save without the optimizer pass
